senses.sense_definition: Giving birth to live young rather than laying eggs.

examples.text: Most mammals are <w>viviparous</w> because they nourish their young inside the mother's body.
Unlike birds, which are oviparous, humans are <w>viviparous</w> creatures.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to plants that produce seeds or embryos that germinate while still attached to the parent plant.

examples.text: Some mangrove species are <w>viviparous</w>, allowing their seedlings to drop into the water already developed.
The <w>viviparous</w> nature of these plants helps them survive in unstable coastal environments.
